notes.title: Released update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings shooters![/h3]

Released update [b]1.0.3[/b] in which:
[list]
[*] Added new languages ( Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Chinese)
[*] Added sounds for items
[*] Fixed a bug with the timer when searching for a match.
[/list]
If you found errors in the translation or bugs, you can write here or join our Discord server and let us know about it. Live shells to everyone!

notes.title: Multilingual Patch 1.0.2 has hit the bar!
notes.content:
Hey, shooters!

We're excited to show you what we've been working on all this time. In this update:
- Fixed custom lobby 
- Added new languages (Ukrainian, Turkish, Russian, French, German and Spanish) 
- New lobby customization options
- New bar (will not replace the current one)

If you found errors in the translation, you can write here or join our Discord server and let us know about it. Also expect a patch with new items in the near future.

Thanks for reading. Live shells to everyone!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is here!
notes.content:
Hi shooters!

In this small update we:
[list]
[*] Added 1v1 battle mode
[*] Fixed a bug with nicknames that could break the lobby
[*] Fixed the volume of sounds in the game
[*] Improved matchmaking system
[/list]

Stay tuned, expect more major updates soon!

notes.title: Buckshot Arena is Ready to Play!
notes.content:
The time has come and now you can finally play Buckshot Arena. 

In the current game version you can expect: 
[list]
[*] A variety of items that will brighten up your gameplay
[*] A lot of character customization
[*] Quick match mode in which you can fight with random opponents from all over the world
[*] Custom lobbies, where you can gather with friends
[/list]

And this is just the beginning! Expect more items and game modes in future updates.

If you like the game, the best way to support us is by [b]writing a review[/b] on Steam. It will help us a lot in promoting the game. We would appreciate it very much!

Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/mpn2d3CxA2]Discord server[/url], where you can share your experience, get support, and even find friends to play with!

Thank you and have fun!
